analytic_review: Exact barycentric signs verify full dimension and every genuine coordinate facet.
General position gives uniform Fourier decay and C1 regularity, including deleted-column densities.
Integration by parts gives f_i=f+b_i dot grad f; facet coarea gives d_i=nV gamma_i.
Weighted complementary minors give R=g(n) f D_gamma and a=E_gamma/D_gamma; the lifted minor scale is 1/sqrt(det MM^T).
The general-position interpolation polynomials are an exact basis by cardinality and nodal values; their sum is identically one.
Laplace uniqueness and C1 regularity justify generic-ray density and gradient limits.
Termwise floor intervals, positive facet products and outward state coarsening preserve every enclosure.
Monotonicity in R and a propagates the seed intervals; the original tail proof with upper constant 8 proves the infinite-limit endpoints.
The new padding family and original finite witnesses give one sequence retaining separation in every dimension at least nine.
